title: Locate spin generation with a grasp-preserving stroke lesion
hypothesis: The frozen controller generates sustained axial spin through its periodic stroke rather than through its mean grasp or nearly powerless spin-feedback modulation.

prediction.rationale: A 15-percentage-point loss would identify a substantial structural lever before spending episodes on repairs; unlike R-053, this removes the periodic stroke rather than reversing saturated feedback.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study r062_stroke_lesion --log-dir logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion"'
code_changes: New study module lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/stroke_lesion.py registered as --study r062_stroke_lesion in scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; settings in the research_protocols block of config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml. The parent is config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent (hashes checked), no fitting, parameters unchanged.

Source audit before any episode: the parent's joint target must be grasp_pose + curl terms + stabilization + rolling * gait, with gait built only from the periodic stroke (sin_phase through drive and the fingertip tangents) and the periodic load (2 * stance - 1); both have zero cycle mean, so replacing the periodic contribution by its cycle mean is the removal of the rolling * gait term. The study exits if the source no longer matches.

Arms, one fresh process each on the frozen 80-case diagnostic manifest (seed 4560): parent; parent_identity (the substitution machinery with the no-op factor 1.0: must be bit-identical to parent in observations and outcomes on all 80 cases, else the lesion is not run); stroke_lesion (+ rolling * gait becomes + 0.0 * rolling * gait; gates still recorded; grasp, curl, centering, tilt correction and execution unchanged). 240 episodes, no LLM call.

Reporting: paired lesion minus parent sustained success with the 95% t interval and win/loss/tie; paired drop difference; failure split (drops vs tail-spin failures); in-play mean |spin| per arm and on the cases the parent sustains; drive saturation and executed-action saturation per axis over recorded in-play steps.

Predeclared interpretation: the periodic stroke is the spin source if lesion minus parent is below -0.15 with the interval entirely below -0.15, the drop difference has an interval through or below zero, and the lesion's in-play mean |spin| on the parent-sustained cases is below the Stage-3 threshold of 4 rad/s. A loss carried by additional drops is inconclusive. An interval entirely above -0.15 refutes the prediction.
Run first; D-048 and D-049 settle the scalar comparison and nothing here repeats it. Final test untouched.

falsified_by: The paired interval for lesion minus parent lies entirely above -0.15. A loss caused primarily by additional drops, rather than reduced pre-drop spin, would leave the proposed spin-generation mechanism inconclusive.

notes: Primary, predeclared: lesion minus parent sustained success on 80 paired cases is -0.0875 [-0.168, -0.007] (2 wins, 9 losses, 69 ties; 6/80 vs 13/80). The interval contains -0.15, so neither the predicted loss of at least 0.15 (needs the interval entirely below -0.15) nor its refutation (needs the lower bound above -0.15) is established: inconclusive by the predeclared rule. The loss itself is established at the 95% level (upper bound -0.007).
The loss is not carried by drops: lesion drops minus parent drops +0.025 per case [-0.046, +0.096] (19 vs 17 of 80); the lesion's extra failures are tail-spin failures (55 vs 50).

Not predeclared, and the main finding: without any periodic stroke the pen still spins. The lesion's in-play mean |spin| over all 80 cases is 6.39 rad/s against the parent's 6.40, and on the 13 cases the parent sustains it is 3.74 against 7.68, with the lesion still sustaining 4 of those 13 (and 6 of 80 overall). The periodic stroke therefore accounts for roughly half of the learner's sustained successes and for the spin rate on its successful cases, but it is not the sole spin source: the reactive stabilization and centering terms (and the curl response), which respond to the pen's own motion through the grasp, generate axial spin on their own. A controller with no stroke scores 0.075 on this manifest.

Saturation unchanged by the lesion: drive above 0.99 on 98.6% (parent) and 97.6% (lesion) of recorded in-play steps; executed-action saturation 6.5% and 7.1% of components. Recorded in-play steps only.

Implication for the deferred R-064 (phase-speed feedback on the stroke): the stroke is a real but partial lever; a timing change can at most move the stroke's share. Implication for R-063 (anticipatory centering): the centering channel already contributes to spin, so changing it changes spin as well as retention.

Accounting: 240 Isaac episodes in three fresh processes, 0 LLM calls, about 3 min wall time. Deviations: none; protocol.seeds was emptied mechanically after approval because the committed manifest carries seed 4560 (as R-053/R-058/R-060). Final-test split untouched.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted a loss of at least 0.15 when the periodic stroke is removed; observed -0.0875 [-0.168, -0.007] on 80 paired cases (6/80 vs 13/80). The interval contains -0.15, so by the predeclared rule the prediction is neither established nor refuted; a loss is established, and it is not carried by drops (+0.025 [-0.046, +0.096]). The informative part is unpredicted: with no stroke at all the pen spins at the same overall mean rate (6.39 vs 6.40 rad/s) and the lesion still sustains 4 of the 13 parent-sustained cases and 6 of 80 overall, so the stroke is a partial lever (about half the successes, and the spin rate on successful cases: 3.74 vs 7.68) and the reactive stabilization and centering terms generate spin on their own. Confidence 0.8: the identity gate was bit-identical on all 80 cases and the audit passed, so the measurement is clean; the uncertainty is the threshold, which 80 cases at a 0.16 base rate cannot resolve.
verdicts.next_experiment: Treat the stroke as a partial spin lever when re-triaging R-064 (timing feedback can move at most the stroke's share) and R-063 (the centering channel is itself a spin source, so an anticipatory centre changes spin, not only retention). A lesion of the stabilization terms would complete the localisation at the same cost; neither follow-up should assume the stroke is the whole mechanism.

verdicts.reasoning: The source audit and bit-identical identity gate passed, making the comparison against the frozen parent interpretable [logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/summary.json]. Against config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent, paired_success_difference was -0.0875 with a 95% interval of [-0.1682, -0.0068]: this establishes a success loss, but the interval straddles -0.15, neither supporting nor refuting the predicted decrease of at least 0.15 [logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/summary.json]. The drop difference was +0.025 with interval [-0.0456, +0.0956], which does not establish unchanged drops or exclude a drop contribution [logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/summary.json]. On parent-sustained cases, lesion mean absolute spin was 3.74 rad/s versus 7.68 for the parent, below the predeclared 4 rad/s threshold [logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/summary.json]. Nevertheless, the lesion sustained success in 6/80 cases; these observations establish a contribution from the periodic stroke but do not identify which remaining controller terms account for residual spin [logs/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion/summary.json].

advisor.reasoning: At 192 simulator episodes and zero LLM calls, this directly tests a source of spin authority not settled by scalar tuning or signed-feedback reversal. Its weakest point is grasp disruption: a success loss driven primarily by additional drops would leave the spin-generation mechanism inconclusive. The prediction is a paired_success_difference decrease of at least 0.15 versus config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent; an interval entirely above -0.15 refutes it, while an interval including zero provides no evidence of a difference. The source-separation audit and bit-identical identity gate make this the appropriate first spend.

implementer.reasoning: The question is right and cheap, and I will run it first, but revise rather than approve: the protocol names an interface and files that do not exist and its gate is under-specified. (1) Interfaces: no --research-spec and no config/pen_spin/r062_stroke_lesion.yaml; the study is --study r062_stroke_lesion with --log-dir, its block in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml, one frozen 80-case Stage-3 diagnostic manifest at config/manifests/pen_spin_stage3_r062_diagnostic_s4560.yaml. (2) Source separation, audited before any episode: the parent's joint target is grasp_pose + curl terms + stabilization (centering and tilt corrections) + rolling * gait, where gait is built only from the periodic stroke (sin_phase, through drive and the tangents) and the periodic load (2 * stance - 1); both periodic terms have zero cycle mean (sin averages to zero, stance = sigmoid(k cos_phase) averages to 0.5 over a roll cycle), so the cycle-mean replacement is exactly the removal of the rolling * gait term. The lesion is a frozen source substitution (+ rolling * gait becomes + 0.0 * rolling * gait, gates still recorded) with the parameters, grasp, centering and execution unchanged; the audit fails the study if the parent source no longer matches that structure. (3) Identity gate on all 80 cases, not 32: the same substitution machinery with the no-op factor 1.0 must be bit-identical to the parent (observations and outcomes, D-045's gate) or the lesion is not run; three processes, 240 episodes. (4) Interpretation rule stated in advance, since a success loss is near-certain and the information is in its form: the stroke is the spin source if lesion minus parent is below -0.15 with the interval below -0.15 AND the lost successes are not drops (lesion drops minus parent drops per case with an interval through or below zero) AND the lesion's in-play mean |spin| is below the Stage-3 threshold of 4 rad/s on the cases the parent sustains; a loss carried by drops is inconclusive, as the falsifier says. Reported: paired success and drop differences with intervals, win/loss/tie, failure split, in-play mean |spin| per arm, drive and executed-action saturation (recorded in-play steps only). No LLM call, final test untouched.
